hero.headline: The modern back office for Lebanese trading companies.
hero.subheadline: Dual-currency accounting, real-time inventory, and point of sale — in one secure, multi-branch platform. Built to replace legacy systems, not just modernize them.

features.heading: Everything your back office needs
features.subheading: One platform for accounting, inventory, and sales.

dualCurrency.title: Dual-currency, built in
dualCurrency.desc: Every transaction, report, and statement in USD and LBP, automatically — not bolted on.

accounting.title: Real double-entry accounting
accounting.desc: Automatic posting, VAT handling, and financial statements that reconcile, every time.

inventory.title: Live inventory across branches
inventory.desc: Stock levels, transfers, and valuation, always accurate, never a manual count away from reality.

pos.title: Point of sale that keeps working
pos.desc: Offline-capable, barcode-ready, synced the moment you're back online.

roles.title: Built for how you actually work
roles.desc: Role-based access, multi-branch, multi-company, in Arabic, French, and English.

audit.title: Full audit trail, always
audit.desc: Every action logged, every posted record immutable, every period lockable.

whySwitch.heading: Why switch
whySwitch.body: Twenty-five years of legacy desktop software got the job done. It's time for something built for how business works today — the same accounting rules you rely on, on modern infrastructure.

demo.heading: See Paradox in action
demo.subheading: Tell us a bit about your business and we'll set up a personalized demo.
